en.navbar.custom.title: Navigation bar
en.navbar.custom.select: No slot selected. Select a slot on the bar to move it, remove it or change how it looks.
en.navbar.custom.available: {available} · drag onto the bar, or press Add
en.navbar.custom.full: Remove a slot to add another.
en.navbar.custom.separators_full: The bar already has four separators.
en.navbar.custom.duplicate: This slot is already on the bar.
en.navbar.custom.stale: The bar changed. Select the slot again.
en.navbar.custom.intro: Choose the controls on the bar at the bottom of the 3D view, and in what order. Drag a slot to move it, or drag it off the bar to remove it.
en.navbar.description.orbit: Turns the view around the model.
en.navbar.description.pan: Slides the view sideways, up or down.
en.navbar.description.zoom: Moves the view closer to or further from the model.
en.navbar.description.spin: Keeps the view turning until you click or press a key.
en.navbar.description.fit: Frames the selection, or the whole model if nothing is selected.
en.navbar.description.look_at: Turns the view to face the selected face, plane or open sketch.
en.navbar.description.home: Returns to the isometric view of the whole model.
en.navbar.description.visual_style: Switches how the model is drawn: shaded, wireframe or with hidden edges.
en.navbar.description.display: Holds the view settings: graphics preset, grid, ground shadow, ambient occlusion and projection.
en.navbar.description.grid: Shows or hides the ground grid.
en.navbar.description.ground_shadow: Shows or hides the shadow under the model.
en.navbar.description.ambient_occlusion: Darkens creases and corners to add depth.
en.navbar.description.projection: Switches between orthographic and perspective views.
en.navbar.description.separator: A thin line that groups neighbouring slots.

zh.navbar.custom.title: 导航栏
zh.navbar.custom.select: 未选择槽位。选择栏上的槽位即可移动、移除或更改其外观。
zh.navbar.custom.full: 请先移除一个槽位以添加其他槽位。
zh.navbar.custom.stale: 导航栏已更改。请重新选择槽位。
zh.navbar.custom.intro: 选择3D视图底部导航栏中的控件及其顺序。拖动槽位可移动，拖出栏外可移除。
zh.navbar.description.pan: 向左右或上下平移视图。
zh.navbar.description.zoom: 将视图拉近或远离模型。
zh.navbar.description.spin: 持续旋转视图，直到点击或按键停止。
zh.navbar.description.fit: 完整显示所选对象；未选择时显示整个模型。
zh.navbar.description.look_at: 使视图正对所选面、平面或打开的草图。
zh.navbar.description.home: 返回显示整个模型的等轴测视图。
zh.navbar.description.visual_style: 切换着色、线框或带隐藏边线等模型绘制方式。
zh.navbar.description.display: 设置图形预设、网格、地面阴影、环境光遮蔽和投影。
zh.navbar.description.ground_shadow: 显示或隐藏模型下方的阴影。
zh.navbar.description.ambient_occlusion: 加深凹槽和角落的阴影，增加深度感。
zh.navbar.description.projection: 切换正交视图和透视视图。
zh.navbar.description.separator: 用于分组相邻槽位的细分隔线。
